title: Remove Gripper Sensor (LOTO tipper, remove gripper cover plate, disconnect M8/M3 connectors)
summary: Safely remove the gripper sensor assembly from the OptiSweep tipper by performing lockout/tagout (LOTO), removing the gripper cover plate, and disconnecting the M8 connector and M3 button-head cap screw (BHCS) connections so the gripper sensor can be removed/replaced.
when_to_use: Use when the gripper sensor needs removal/replacement on an OptiSweep tipper and you must first secure the tipper using the Operator Station Lockout/Tagout controls.
not_for: Do not proceed with removal steps if the tipper cannot be confirmed locked out via the Operator Station Lockout/Tagout controls.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform on-site LOTO and the physical removal/disconnection steps (gripper cover plate removal; disconnect M8 connector and M3 BHCS).
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the Operator Station Lockout/Tagout controls/locations referenced in the manual.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical floor access to the tipper

access_required: Physical floor access to the tipper
system_preconditions: Tipper is secured using LOTO via the Operator Station Lockout/Tagout controls/locations referenced in the manual.

visual_references.description: Figure 7-10 (Pneumatic Cylinder Replacement) includes the manual’s gripper cover removal step context: “Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.” Useful for visual orientation of the gripper cover area on the tipper station.

steps.title: LOTO the tipper using Operator Station Lockout/Tagout
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out before any physical removal/disconnection work.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” controls/locations referenced in the manual (page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out (LOTO applied) and you can proceed with gripper sensor removal steps.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is confirmed before proceeding to remove the gripper cover plate.
steps.failure_condition: Tipper is not confirmed locked out; removal work begins without LOTO verification.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-verify LOTO if the tipper is not confirmed locked out before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.2.2.1: REMOVAL 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove the gripper cover plate
steps.purpose: Expose the gripper sensor connections so the M8 connector and M3 BHCS can be disconnected.
steps.expected_result: The gripper cover plate is removed.
steps.healthy_condition: Gripper cover plate is fully removed, providing access to the gripper sensor connections.
steps.failure_condition: Cover plate removal is incomplete or prevents access to the M8 connector and M3 BHCS.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.2.2.1: REMOVAL 2. Remove the gripper cover plate.

steps.title: Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 BHCS
steps.purpose: Disconnect the electrical/mechanical connections that attach the gripper sensor assembly.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the M8 connector and the M3 button-head cap screw (BHCS).
steps.expected_result: The M8 connector is disconnected and the M3 BHCS is disconnected so the gripper sensor can be removed/replaced.
steps.healthy_condition: Both the M8 connector and M3 BHCS are fully disconnected without damage or excessive force.
steps.failure_condition: M8 connector or M3 BHCS cannot be disconnected without excessive force.

actions.label: Disconnect M8 and M3
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 BHCS.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the M8 connector or M3 BHCS cannot be disconnected without excessive force, stop and escalate for assistance rather than forcing components.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.2.2.1: REMOVAL 3. Disconnect the M8 connector and M3 BHCS.

steps.title: Prepare the gripper sensor for replacement/removal
steps.purpose: Set conditions for the next maintenance action (sensor removal/replacement) after the connections are disconnected.
steps.instruction: Prepare the gripper sensor for replacement/removal after the M8 connector and M3 BHCS are disconnected.
steps.expected_result: The gripper sensor is ready to be removed/replaced following disconnection of the M8 connector and M3 BHCS.
steps.healthy_condition: Connections are disconnected and the sensor can be handled for removal/replacement without being still attached via the M8/M3 connection points.
steps.failure_condition: Sensor cannot be prepared for removal/replacement because the M8 connector or M3 BHCS remains connected or obstructed.

actions.label: Verify disconnection readiness
actions.exact_action: Prepare the gripper sensor for replacement/removal after the M8 connector and M3 BHCS are disconnected.

source_evidence.quote: 7.3.2.2.1: REMOVAL (section heading and steps shown in provided text include LOTO, remove gripper cover plate, and disconnect M8 connector and M3 BHCS; preparation for replacement/removal is the next action implied by the candidate goal/expected result).

success_criteria: Tipper is locked out using Operator Station Lockout/Tagout controls.
M8 connector and M3 BHCS are disconnected so the gripper sensor can be removed/replaced.
healthy_conditions: Gripper cover plate removal provides access to the M8 connector and M3 BHCS.
M8 connector and M3 BHCS disconnect without excessive force.
failure_conditions: Tipper is not confirmed locked out before proceeding.
M8 connector or M3 BHCS cannot be disconnected without excessive force.
escalation_guidance: If the M8 connector or M3 BHCS cannot be disconnected without excessive force, stop and escalate for assistance rather than forcing components.
